text.p: Italian bond futures edged higher in early trade following overnight gains in T-bonds with most volume coming from the switch over to December from September LIFFE contracts today, dealers said.
The LIFFE September in London expires at 1030 GMT today and dealers said there will be some artifical trading until the switch over of contracts is complete.

Dealers added worries over the forthcoming 1997 budget will keep a cap on prices, while investors are awaiting Thursday's Italian CPI figures and U.S. economic data this week culminating in August jobs figure on Friday.
Dealers said the steady lira was supporting contracts early, but concerns over the budget battles for the 1997 that lies ahead could have a depressing effect on prices.
